question: What is the hardest month to sell a house in Sebring, FL?
answer: August and September are historically the slowest months to sell real estate in Sebring and Highlands County. Late summer coincides with peak humidity, the height of Atlantic hurricane season, and the off-season absence of northern winter residents (snowbirds). Buyer foot traffic begins rebounding in October and peaks between January and April. However, serious motivated buyers—such as relocated healthcare professionals at AdventHealth Sebring—purchase year-round, meaning a properly priced home with aggressive digital marketing can sell quickly in any month.
